effect_description_eng:
[Main] You may play 1 Digimon card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less in your hand without paying its memory cost. Then, place this card in your battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Place those cards on the top or bottom of your deck in any order.
